name: Pyramid buster's kit
body:
Source Undead Slayer's Handbook pg. 9
Price 310 gp; Weight 8 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
This kit contains items helpful in navigating the winding corridors of pyramids, but is also useful in other crypts and tombs. It contains three sticks of chalk, five sheets of parchment, 1 dose of synthetic mumia, a flask of alchemist’s fire, a tangleburn bagUE, and a pair of sunrods.
